quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that grows underground and soaks up water!
quests.hint: You cannot see this part of the plant because it hides below the soil.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Root is correct because it grows underground and takes in water for the plant.
quests.funFact: Some tree roots can grow even longer than the tree is tall!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that carries water up from the roots to the leaves!
quests.hint: This thin, upright part connects the roots to the flower on top.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Stem is correct because it carries water up to the leaves and flower.
quests.funFact: Some plant stems can grow taller than a grown-up in just one summer!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that is a soft, colorful piece around the center of a flower!
quests.hint: A flower usually has several of these arranged in a pretty circle.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Petal is correct because it is a soft, colorful part around a flower's center.
quests.funFact: Some flowers have just a few petals, while others have over a hundred!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that is a small, closed shape before it opens into a flower!
quests.hint: This tiny, closed shape is a flower that hasn't opened up yet.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Bud is correct because it is a flower before it has opened up.
quests.funFact: Some flower buds open in just one day, while others take weeks!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a spiky green plant living in hot, dry places!
quests.hint: This prickly plant can store water inside itself for many months.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Cactus is correct because it is a spiky plant that stores water in dry places.
quests.funFact: A cactus can survive for over a year without a single drop of rain!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that has long leaves and grows near warm, sandy beaches!
quests.hint: You often see this tall plant swaying gently in the ocean breeze.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Palm Tree is correct because it grows near warm beaches with long, swaying leaves.
quests.funFact: Coconuts grow high up at the top of this very tree!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that pops up on the forest floor after it rains!
quests.hint: This little umbrella-shaped growth is not a plant at all.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Mushroom is correct because it grows on the forest floor, often after rain.
quests.funFact: A mushroom is not a plant — it belongs to its very own group called fungi!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is hot, dry, and covered in sand!
quests.hint: It almost never rains in this dry, sandy place.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Desert is correct because it is a hot, dry place covered in sand.
quests.funFact: Even though deserts are hot in the day, they can get very cold at night!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is land completely surrounded by water!
quests.hint: You need a boat or a plane to reach this piece of land.
quests.explanation: That's right! An Island is correct because it is land surrounded on all sides by water.
quests.funFact: Some islands are so small that only a few trees can fit on them!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is covered in sand next to the sea!
quests.hint: You can build sandcastles and collect seashells in this sandy place.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Beach is correct because it is the sandy place found next to the sea.
quests.funFact: Beach sand is often made of tiny bits of broken shells and rocks!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a mountain which can shoot out hot melted rock!
quests.hint: Deep inside this mountain, rock gets so hot that it turns into glowing liquid.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Volcano is correct because it is a mountain that can shoot out hot, melted rock.
quests.funFact: There are volcanoes on Earth that have been asleep for hundreds of years!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is a dark, hollow space inside a mountain or under the ground!
quests.hint: Bats like to rest and sleep inside this dark, quiet space.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Cave is correct because it is a dark, hollow space inside rock or underground.
quests.funFact: Some caves have colorful rock formations that took thousands of years to form!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that grows underwater and looks like colorful branches of rock!
quests.hint: Many colorful fish like to swim and hide around this underwater home.
quests.explanation: That's right! Coral is correct because it grows underwater like colorful, branching rock.
quests.funFact: Coral is actually made by tiny living creatures, even though it looks like a plant or rock!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a soft, tiny green plant growing on rocks and tree trunks!
quests.hint: This soft, green carpet often grows in damp, shady places.
quests.explanation: Yes! Moss is correct because it is the soft green plant that grows on rocks and tree trunks.
quests.funFact: Moss has no roots at all — it soaks up water straight through its tiny leaves!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that floats with round leaves on top of a calm pond!
quests.hint: Frogs love to sit on the round, flat leaves of this pretty plant.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Lily is correct because it floats on ponds with round leaves and pretty flowers.
quests.funFact: Some pond lily leaves are big enough for a small frog to sit on!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that holds a plant firmly in the ground!
quests.hint: This part keeps a tall tree standing strong, even in windy weather.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Root is correct because it holds the plant firmly in the ground.
quests.funFact: Carrots are actually a root that we like to eat!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that a flower sits on top of!
quests.hint: You often have to snip this part when picking flowers for a vase.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Stem is correct because the flower sits right on top of it.
quests.funFact: A stem can be soft and bendy or hard and woody, depending on the plant!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that falls off a flower one by one as it wilts!
quests.hint: The color and smell of a flower mostly comes from these soft parts.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Petal is correct because these colorful parts eventually fall off as a flower wilts.
quests.funFact: People have used flower petals to make perfume for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Identify the plant part that slowly unfolds its petals in the warm spring sun!
quests.hint: You might see this small, tightly wrapped shape on a branch in early spring.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Bud is correct because it slowly unfolds into a flower in the spring.
quests.funFact: Tree buds can stay tightly closed all winter to protect themselves from the cold!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is covered in sharp spines instead of leaves!
quests.hint: This plant grows well in sandy places where it almost never rains.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Cactus is correct because it has sharp spines instead of regular leaves.
quests.funFact: Some cactus plants can grow as tall as a two-story house!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object with a tall, thin trunk and a crown of big leaves on top!
quests.hint: This tall plant does not have branches like most others do.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Palm Tree is correct because it has a tall trunk with a crown of leaves on top.
quests.funFact: There are more than two thousand five hundred kinds of palm trees around the world!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object shaped like a tiny umbrella growing near tree roots!
quests.hint: Many of these grow in damp, shady spots under the trees.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Mushroom is correct because it grows in damp, shady spots and looks like a tiny umbrella.
quests.funFact: Some mushrooms can glow softly in the dark!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place where cactus plants grow easily in the sand!
quests.hint: This place gets very little rain all year long.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Desert is correct because it is the dry, sandy place where cactus plants thrive.
quests.funFact: The Sahara Desert in Africa is almost as big as the entire United States!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place where palm trees often grow along sandy shores!
quests.hint: This piece of land has water all around it, with no bridge to the mainland.
quests.explanation: Yes! An Island is correct because it is land with water on every side.
quests.funFact: Greenland is the biggest island in the whole world!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place where ocean waves roll gently onto the sand!
quests.hint: Families often visit this sunny, sandy spot in the summer.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Beach is correct because ocean waves roll onto its sandy shore.
quests.funFact: Not all beach sand is light colored — some beaches have black or even pink sand!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that can send smoke and ash high into the sky!
quests.hint: This special mountain has an opening right at its very top.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Volcano is correct because it can send smoke and ash into the sky through its opening.
quests.funFact: New islands in the ocean are sometimes formed by volcanoes erupting under the water!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that stays cool and dark, even on a hot sunny day!
quests.hint: Long ago, people used spaces like this for shelter from the weather.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Cave is correct because it stays cool and dark inside, no matter the weather outside.
quests.funFact: The longest cave system in the world stretches for hundreds of miles underground!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that builds a colorful reef for ocean life to live in!
quests.hint: This underwater structure can look pink, orange, or even purple.
quests.explanation: Well done! Coral is correct because it builds the colorful reefs where ocean life lives.
quests.funFact: The Great Barrier Reef is so huge it can even be seen all the way from space!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that feels like a soft green carpet in a shady forest!
quests.hint: This tiny plant grows best where the ground rarely dries out.
quests.explanation: Great job! Moss is correct because it grows like a soft carpet in shady, damp forest spots.
quests.funFact: Moss has been growing on Earth for over four hundred million years!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that opens its pretty flower on top of still water!
quests.hint: This plant's roots reach all the way down into the mud below the water.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Lily is correct because its flower opens on top of still water.
quests.funFact: Some water lily flowers only open during the daytime and close again at night!
